sources.title: qwen3-vl-plus model card
sources.evidence: Complete indexed card gives text/image/video input, text output, 262144-token context and regional function-calling support. Direct fetch exceeded the browser's size limit; indexed content was accessible. Counts and architecture are absent.

sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: Release table explicitly lists qwen3-vl-plus and qwen3-vl-plus-2025-09-23 on 2025-09-23; describes thinking/non-thinking modes, visual agents, spatial perception and long-video understanding. Later regional/update rows do not replace initial availability.

sources.title: Model inference pricing
sources.evidence: Indexed pricing documentation says the qwen3-vl-plus alias is currently equivalent to qwen3-vl-plus-2025-12-19 and supports thinking and non-thinking modes.

sources.title: Qwen3-VL official repository
sources.evidence: Identifies Qwen3-VL as developed by Qwen team, Alibaba Cloud. Lists separately named open checkpoints, including 235B-A22B Instruct and Thinking; does not identify either as the Plus API alias. Its Apache-2.0 repository license does not establish a Plus weights license.

sources.title: Qwen API platform
sources.evidence: Indexed platform page names Qwen3-VL-Plus and text/image/video-to-text modalities, but lists 131027 context length. This conflicts with the exact Alibaba Cloud model card's 262144; no reconciliation is supplied. Direct page extraction returned no text.

patch.description: Alibaba Cloud Qwen3 vision-language API model for visual reasoning, spatial understanding, video understanding and visual agent tasks, with optional thinking.
patch.notes: Hosted alias currently documented as equivalent to qwen3-vl-plus-2025-12-19. Parameter counts and architecture are undisclosed; no equivalence to an open Qwen3-VL checkpoint is established. Function calling is documented for Beijing but unsupported in the other listed regional deployments. Context is the exact Alibaba Cloud card's indexed specification; Qwen's platform page lists a conflicting 131027. Open-weight status was not independently established.

summary: Adds omitted video input and a description grounded in exact-alias documentation. Confirms 2025-09-23 release, optional thinking and 262144 context subject to the recorded primary-source conflict. Tool calling is region-dependent. Total/active parameters, architecture and license remain undisclosed; open-weight status remains unverified. No open-checkpoint counts or architecture are transferred to Plus.
